en: Color photograph with scalloped edges showing a white three‑masted sailing ship moored by a green, tree‑lined shore. In the blurred foreground there is a large rusted iron mooring ring on a quay, framing the ship in its center. Behind the ship stands a historic brick building with towers and spires, and a small flag that appears to be the Swedish flag. The scene is on calm water under a cloudy sky.
